newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Hong Leong to sell property firm.
newsitem.headline: Hong Leong to sell property firm.

text.p: Hong Leong Properties Bhd said its Guobena Sdn Bhd unit has agreed to sell its property investment firm to construction concern Esprit Group Bhd for 55.57 million ringgit.

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange late on Wednesday, Hong Leong Properties said the sale of Guobena Development Sdn Bhd is to be satisfied by an issue of 7.12 million new Esprit shares at 7.80 ringgit a share.

Guobena Sdn Bhd has also entered into a separate agreement with Esprit's chief executive officer Goh Chee Khen for the sale of 50 percent of the new Esprit shares under the proposed transaction, the statement said.

Hong Leong Properties said the proposed sale would allow it to realise the capital appreciation of its investment and is not expected to have any impact on its earnings for the current financial year ending June 30, 1997.
But the transaction will increase Hong Leong Properties' net tangible asset per share to 0.804 ringgit from 0.79 ringgit, it said.
Shares of Esprit have been suspended since June 4, when they closed at 11.00 ringgit. Hong Leong Properties ended at 2.90 ringgit on Wednesday.
